Only three people sit between K and I, when counted from the left of K. B sits to the immediate right of D. J is an immediate neighbour of L as well as I. Who sits second to the left of C?

questions.question: Rakesh ranked 13th from the top and 18th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in the class?
questions.solution:
Given:

Rakesh is 13th from the top.

Rakesh is 18th from the bottom.

**Total = Rank from Top + Rank from Bottom - 1**

Number of students = 13 + 18 - 1

= 31 - 1

= 30 students.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some samosas are burgers.

Some burgers are pizzas.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some samosas are pizzas.

(II): All pizzas are burgers.
questions.solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d07e4a041d08a2481c7b1331ec5bd6a0c78c7f11f4c8eb49b76c2f6fc4a66c04.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90b472bdb7af95e886a40be75565df629df8ddd31465a88b28b010e20065235b.png] 

Conclusions:

 (I) Some samosas are pizzas → Does not follow (There is no direct relation given between samosas and pizzas. so, it is possible not definite).

(II) All pizzas are burgers → Does not follow (As some burgers are pizzas. so, All pizzas are burger is not true).

Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 4”.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

 (12, 20, 45) 

 (18, 26, 57)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 1st number + 8 = 2nd number

2nd number × 2 + 5 = 3rd number.

Now,

For, (12, 20, 45)

⇒ 12 + 8 = 20

⇒ (20 × 2) + 5 = 40 + 5 = 45.

For, (18, 26, 57)

⇒ 18 + 8 = 26

⇒ (26 × 2) + 5 = 52 + 5 = 57.

Similarly, for (13, 21, 47)

**⇒ 13 + 8 = 21**

⇒ **(21 × 2) + 5 = 42 + 5 = 47.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
